name: main
note: console entry: parses options, loads the profile, compiles the pattern, streams matches (references the usage/banner strings)

name: ExpandQueryMacros
note: replaces unescaped @ and # with the configured expansions; \x pairs are copied verbatim

name: LoadPatternOptions
note: reads ExpansionAt, ExpansionHash, VariablesExclusive, IgnoreUnusedPunctuation from the registry profile

name: FilterWordByCaseMode
note: copies a word into a new string under mode 1..4 (all / letters only / letters upper-cased / letters lower-cased)

name: TEAViewProfileWindows::Load
note: reads fonts, colours, view settings and the open-dictionary list from the registry profile; class membership inferred from position next to the destructor

name: TSDictionaryList::ReleaseDictionaries
note: drops one reference on every listed Dictionary in the shared cache and deletes those reaching zero

name: TSDictionaryList::GetCount
note: number of dictionaries (vector size)

name: TSDictionaryList::GetNumLengths
note: dictionary header num_lengths (u16 at Dictionary+0x240c)

name: TSDictionaryList::GetWordStreamOffset
note: word_stream_offsets[length] (u32 table at Dictionary+0x2410)

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Dictionary
note: constructor: installs the vtable, copies the path string

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Load
note: vtable slot 1. Reads the .tsd header (magic TSD0/TSD1), Huffman table and calibration matrix; builds the 8-bit lookahead decode tables

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Unload
note: vtable slot 2. Frees the calibration matrix and clears the loaded state

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::EnsureCurrent
note: vtable slot 3. Reloads when the file's timestamp no longer matches; returns the loaded flag

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetFileTitle
note: vtable slot 5

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetCounts
note: vtable slot 10. Sums the per-length count tables into four totals

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetSummaryText
note: vtable slot 7. Formats the Headwords / Definitions / Description text

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetFileDateText
note: vtable slot 8. Formats the file time with GetDateFormatA

name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetDescription
note: vtable slot 9. Returns the header description string (Dictionary+0x2014)

name: GetFileTitleString
note: GetFileTitleA wrapper returning a std::string

name: GetProgramDirectory
note: GetModuleFileNameA, truncated after the last backslash

name: ReadFileTime
note: opens the file read-only and calls GetFileTime

name: InputEngine::InputEngine
note: constructor(list, dictionaryIndex): links the engine into the global InputEngine list

name: InputEngine::StartLength
note: selects one word-length bucket: looks up word_stream_offsets[L], skips empty buckets, opens the file, clears the word buffer

name: InputEngine::NextMatch
note: Huffman-decodes words of the current length (8-bit lookahead table, then bit-by-bit trie walk), at most 2000 per call, testing each against the MatchEngineSet

name: MatchEngineSet::EvalLogic
note: boolean VM over the logic bytecode: 1=OR 2=AND 3=END 4=open paren 5=close paren, bit 0x08=NOT. mode 0 = precomputed flags, 1 = length pre-check (NOT is skipped), 2 = match the word. The 0x412000 address in your notes is this function in TEA.exe

name: InputEngine::OpenFile
note: CreateFileA + seek to the saved offset; on ERROR_TOO_MANY_OPEN_FILES closes another engine's handle from the global list and retries

name: InputEngine::GetAnnotation
note: returns the text following the display word's NUL, or NULL when empty. The 0x4122bc address in your notes is this function in TEA.exe

name: MatchEngine::CompilePattern
note: recursive [template][;anagram] parser; mutually recursive with CompileTemplate / CompileAnagram. Not read line by line

name: MatchEngine::CompileTemplate
note: template-side compiler (choice lists, escapes per your notes). Role inferred from call structure

name: MatchEngine::CompileAnagram
note: anagram-side compiler; uses the Pattern pool. Role inferred from call structure

name: MatchEngine::Compile
note: compiles one leaf pattern and selects the fast-path matcher stored at +0x114c

name: MatchEngine::IsValid
note: returns the int at +0x1020; MatchEngineSet::Compile treats 0 as a compile failure

name: MatchEngine::GetStatus
note: returns the status byte at +0x1024

name: MatchEngine::MatchEngine
note: constructor: Pattern pool, empty bytecode string, shortest=1, longest=100, matcher=MatchGeneral

name: MatchEngine::SetShortest
note: clamps to 1..100 and stores at +0x1134

name: MatchEngine::SetLongest
note: clamps to 1..100 and stores at +0x1138

name: MatchEngine::SetWordLength
note: stores the candidate length (+0x113c) and the slack over the template minimum (+0x1140)

name: MatchEngine::MatchWord
note: builds the punctuation-prefix and filtered raw buffers when needed, then calls the selected matcher

name: MatchEngine::FormatBalance
note: renders the anagram balance table as text. Entry checked; body only skimmed

name: MatchEngine::GetMinLength
note: max(shortest setting, compiled min_len)

name: MatchEngine::GetMaxLength
note: min(longest setting, compiled max_len)

name: MatchEngine::ResetMatchState
note: clears the variable-binding flag and the balance flag before a match

name: MatchEngine::MatchFixedTemplate
note: fast path: (offset, letter) pairs compared in sequence until an opcode >= 0xf0

name: MatchEngine::MatchDistinctAnagram
note: fast path for anagrams of distinct letters. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::MatchMultiAnagram
note: fast path for anagrams with repeated letters. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::RunTemplateVM
note: backtracking template bytecode interpreter. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::AnagramSingleLetters
note: anagram opcode 0xf5 operand walker: <count> <letter...>

name: MatchEngine::AnagramMultiLetters
note: anagram opcode 0xf6: (multiplicity, letter) pairs checked against the letter histogram with an omission budget

name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceLists
note: anagram opcode 0xf7 solver. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceListsOp
note: fetches the Pattern pool slot and calls AnagramChoiceLists

name: MatchEngine::AnagramVariables
note: anagram opcode 0xf8. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::AnagramSubPattern
note: anagram opcode 0xfa. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::RunAnagramVM
note: anagram bytecode interpreter. Entry checked; body not read

name: MatchEngine::ComputeBalance
note: fills the 256-entry balance table: +1 per candidate letter, minus the letters the anagram consumed

name: MatchEngine::MatchGeneral
note: default matcher installed by the constructor; snapshots variable bindings around the template VM

name: VariableValues::Bind
note: binds variable 0..9 to a letter if unbound (0xfe) and, when exclusive, not already used

name: VariableValues::Get
note: pointer to the binding slot for one variable

name: VariableValues::IsLetterBound
note: true when the exclusive option is on and another variable already holds this letter

name: VariableValues::Clear
note: marks all ten variables unbound (0xfe)

name: VariableValues::Save
note: copies the ten bindings into a snapshot

name: VariableValues::Restore
note: restores the ten bindings from a snapshot

name: Pattern::Pattern
note: constructor: count=0 and 256 empty 16-byte strings

name: Pattern::Add
note: returns the index of an equal entry or appends (capacity 256)

name: Pattern::Clear
note: count = 0

name: Pattern::At
note: address of slot n (8 + n*16)

name: Persist::Persist
note: opens or creates the registry key (RegOpenKeyExA / RegCreateKeyExA)

name: Persist::QueryValueSized
note: RegQueryValueExA wrapper

name: Persist::QueryValue
note: RegQueryValueExA wrapper

name: MatchEngineSet::Compile
note: splits the expanded query on & | ! ( ), creates one MatchEngine per leaf and calls MatchEngine::Compile; returns the first leaf's error status

name: operator_delete
note: called on `this` at the end of every deleting destructor

name: operator_new
note: result is null-checked and passed to a constructor

name: _vector_new_ldtc_
note: Borland RTL array constructor helper (ptr, elemSize, count, mode, ctor)

name: _vector_delete_ldtc_
note: Borland RTL array destructor helper (ptr, elemSize, count, mode, dtor)

name: std::string::string_from_cstr
note: std::string(const char*)

name: std::string::__getRep
note: allocates a string representation of the given capacity

name: std::string::replace_fill
note: replace(pos, n1, n2, ch); with pos=size,n1=0 it appends n2 copies of ch

name: __InitExceptBlockLDTC
note: Borland exception-frame setup; first call in most functions, argument is that function's exception table

name: calloc
note: malloc(n*size) then memset 0

name: malloc
note: called by operator new in a retry loop

name: free
note: called by operator delete
